sample.origin: official central production (LHCb TestFileDB), not self-generated
sample.format: XDIGI (digitised banks + packed MC truth pSim/...)
sample.conditions: Simulation; DDDB dddb-20231017, CondDB sim-20231017-vc-mu100, DataType 2024
sample.access: local CVMFS mirror /cvmfs/lhcbdev.cern.ch/testfiledb-mirror/ (5 of the entry's 8 files, 19 GB) - no EOS, kerberos or DIRAC
sample.event_numbers: 0-199, the 0-based index in the concatenated file stream

population: states harvested from tracker MCHits (see harvest_states.py + results/harvest_summary.json)

labels.engine: fp64 fixed-step RK4, step_mm=5.0, ODE identical to Allen (deriv mirrored from track-extrapolation-pinn/datagen/generate_data_v2.py)

leg_types.A: first VP state -> its PV z (backward)
leg_types.D: first T state -> its PV z (backward)

core_selection: non-electron & origin radius < 10 mm & 1.8 < eta < 5.2 (flag CORE; tails kept, selectable)

G2_label_vs_next_hit_mm.meaning: residual = material effects (scattering/dE), out of label scope by design

format.note: labels computed in fp64, stored fp32 (same as vertex-fit corpus)
